title: Network Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Network Support Engineer at our NOC to provide enterprise-level assistance to our

customers. You will diagnose and troubleshoot software and hardware problems and help our customers

install applications and programs delivered Network & Security WAN solutions.

Network Support Engineer responsibilities include resolving network issues, configuring operating

systems, and using remote desktop connections to provide immediate support. You will use email and

chat applications to give clients quick answers to simple IT issues. For more complex problems that

require nuanced instruction, you will contact clients via phone and/or provide clear, written instructions

and technical manuals.

Ultimately, you will be a person our customer's trust. They will rely on you to provide timely and accurate

solutions to their technical problems.

**Responsibilities:**

● Research and identify solutions to software and hardware issues

● Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, including account setup and network configuration

● Ask customers targeted questions to understand the root of the problem quickly

● Track computer system issues through to resolution, within agreed time limits

● Talk clients through a series of actions, either via phone, email or chat, until they’ve solved a technical issue

● Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams as per SLA

● Provide prompt and accurate feedback to customers

● Refer to internal database or external resources to provide accurate tech solutions

● Ensure all issues are properly logged

● Prioritize and manage several open issues at one time

● Follow up with clients to ensure their IT systems are fully functional after troubleshooting

● Prepare accurate and timely reports

● Document technical knowledge in the form of notes and manuals

● Maintain jovial relationships with clients

● Configure and install various network devices and services (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS)

● Perform network maintenance and system upgrades including service packs, patches, hot fixes and security configurations

● Monitor performance and ensure system availability and reliability

● Monitor system resource utilization, trending, and capacity planning

● Provide Level-2/3 support and troubleshooting to resolve issues

● Work within established configuration and change management policies to ensure awareness,

approval, and success of changes made to the network infrastructure

● Select and implement security tools, policies, and procedures in conjunction with the company’s

security team

● Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution

* Requirements

**Technical Skills:**

● Proven hands-on network engineering and customer support experience

● Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot basic technical issues

● Familiarity with remote desktop applications and help desk software like ( Zoho, Zendesk, or similar)

● Ability to provide step-by-step technical help, both written and verbal

● Deep understanding of networking protocols (e.g., IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, QoS)

● Support in -Routing, Switching, IP Protocol, VLAN, LAN, WAN, MPLS, ILL, Broadband,4G/5G.technical & non-technical work

● Solid understanding of the OSI or TCP/IP model

● Hands-on experience with monitoring, network diagnostic, and network analytics tools

● Proven work experience as a Technical Support Engineer, Desktop Support Engineer, IT Help Desk Technician, or similar role

**Behavioral Skills:**

● Technical educational background - Graduation

● Proven working experience as a network engineer.

● Excellent client-facing , problem Solving and internal communication Skills

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills

● Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills

**Qualifications:** Graduates/ Postgraduates from IT background preferred

**Experience:** 1 to 3 Years

**Certification:** must have CCNA Certified. SDWAN certification is optional & added advantages CCNA

Trained can apply too.

title: Sr Process Engineer
description:
As a **Sr. Process Engineer** at Honeywell, you will lead the deployment of a world-class operating system across our global PT-Sundyne manufacturing network. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, manufacturing standardization, productivity improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, delivery, inventory, and cost performance across multiple sites.

You will serve as a key change agent, partnering with site leadership teams to identify and eliminate waste, optimize value streams, strengthen management systems, and accelerate sustainable business results. Through the application of Lean, Six Sigma, and Honeywell operational excellence principles, you will help build a culture of accountability, problem solving, and continuous improvement across Sundyne operations.

You will report directly to the **Senior Director, ISC Operations** and may be based in **Arvada, Colorado** or **Pune, India** , operating on a hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will have a direct impact on operational performance, manufacturing consistency, and strategic growth by leading transformation initiatives, coaching leaders, and driving execution of business-wide operational excellence priorities.

  

**You Must Have**
-----------------

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Business, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, quality, engineering, or operational excellence.
* Demonstrated success leading Lean transformation and continuous improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Root Cause Analysis, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Experience influencing and leading cross-functional teams in a matrixed, global organization.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive business decisions and operational improvements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, facilitation, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel to PT-Sundyne manufacturing locations as business needs require.

**We Value**
------------

* Proven experience leading multi-site operational excellence transformations.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operating systems and production management practices.
* Experience within engineered products, industrial equipment, aerospace, energy, or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to connect operational improvements to broader business objectives.
* A proactive, results-oriented leader who thrives in dynamic environments and drives change through influence and collaboration.
* Passion for developing people and creating high-performing teams.
* Ability to balance governance, standardization, and process discipline with practical business execution.

  

* Lead the development and execution of the PT-Sundyne Operational Excellence strategy across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Drive sustainable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and cost performance through Lean and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Partner with site leadership teams to establish standardized operating practices and strengthen management operating systems.
* Facilitate value stream assessments, Kaizen events, problem-solving workshops, and transformation activities focused on measurable business results.
* Identify system-level improvement opportunities and lead cross-functional teams in implementing scalable solutions.
* Utilize data and performance metrics to prioritize improvement efforts, monitor progress, and ensure accountability.
* Champion root cause problem solving and disciplined execution across manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, and support functions.
* Coach and develop leaders, managers, and site teams on Operational Excellence principles, Lean methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.
* Share best practices across the global manufacturing network and drive replication of successful improvements.
* Foster a culture of engagement, ownership, and continuous learning throughout the organization.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Network & Integration Engineer
description:
Role summary

You connect Azure to the client's on-premises network and to every third party the hospital system talks to. You build the network, make the tunnels resilient, and prove each integration works before cutover. This is the role most exposed to external coordination, so clear communication matters as much as technical depth.

* Build hub-and-spoke VNets, Azure Firewall, routing and NSGs
* Configure site-to-site IPsec tunnels (dual ISP, with failover) and point-to-site VPN
* Produce exact on-premises firewall and VPN settings for the client's network team, and run joint tunnel tests (on-prem changes are made by the client)
* Establish and test connectivity for PACS/DICOM, lab systems, NPHIES, RCM, ERP and ZATCA
* Coordinate partner IP allowlisting for the new Azure addresses and chase partners for test access
* Contribute to the cutover night: integration switch-over and smoke tests

Network as-built · firewall and NSG rule export · on-premises settings sheet · tunnel configuration and failover test report · integration matrix and integration test report

Must-have

* 5+ years in enterprise networking with 3+ years on Azure networking
* Hands-on with IPsec site-to-site VPN, BGP or static routing, and failover design
* Azure Firewall, NSGs, UDRs, Private Endpoints and DNS resolution in hybrid setups
* Comfortable troubleshooting with packet captures and firewall logs
* Experience working with the client's third-party firewall vendors (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco or similar)
* Ability to document and explain network changes clearly to non-Azure network teams
* AZ-700 or CCNP-level knowledge (or equivalent experience)

Good to have

* Healthcare integrations: DICOM/PACS, HL7, lab interfaces
* Familiarity with Saudi integrations such as NPHIES and ZATCA e-invoicing
* Experience with partner allowlisting and VPN-based B2B connectivity

What independence looks like

You can take a network diagram, build it, give the client a precise settings sheet, and get dual-ISP tunnels passing a failover test with minimal back-and-forth.

title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune


Senior Vice President


Pune, India


**About Infrastructure Technology**

The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.


**Core Infrastructure Platforms**

The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.  



**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
